d: Tivoli Hotels & Resorts is a collection of luxury hotels and resorts set in idyllic beaches and cosmopolitan locations, from iconic destinations in Europe to the Middle East, and from Brazil to Asia. We are timeless, dedicated, and distinctive — evoking a time when hotel stays were grand experiences and travel meant life slowed down for a while.

Founded in 1933, Tivoli’s long-standing heritage is built on extraordinary service, authentic local experiences, and a genuine dedication to the art of hospitality. If you share a passion for making every guest feel they have arrived somewhere truly special, Tivoli is where your story belongs.

This role is critical in establishing the overall Revenue strategy for both Tivoli Bilaj Al Jazayer Bahrain Resort and Avani Bilaj Al Jazayer Bahrain Resort. You will be responsible for maximizing total revenue, optimizing pricing and distribution, and driving market positioning through data-led decision making, while aligning with brand standards and commercial objectives.
q: Bachelor's degree in hotel management or finance.
2 years holding a Revenue Manager position at comparible hotel.
Familiar with the hotel operations, available technology (PMS & RMS) and all distributionchannels.
Understand the dynamics of regional & local markets, as well as local competitors and events.
Key Competencies Required; Coaching & Developing Others, Facilitating Change, Aligning Strategies into Results, Innovation, Problem Analysis and Decision Making.
